
# Packages

```{r packages}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(boot)
```

# Data Loading & Cleaning

```{r load-data}

unp_data_raw <- fromJSON("../judge_output_final/unprompted_judge_results_multiturn_gemini-2.5-flash.json")
syc_data_raw <- fromJSON("../judge_output_final/sycophantic_judge_results_multiturn_gemini-2.5-flash.json")
# cont_data_raw <- fromJSON("../judge_output_final/contrarian_judge_results_multiturn_gemini-2.5-flash.json")


df_unp <- as_tibble(unp_data_raw) %>%
  select(case_id, topic_key, user_stance, classified_response) %>%
  unnest(classified_response) %>% 
  select(case_id, topic_key, user_stance, turn, mean_score)


df_syc <- as_tibble(syc_data_raw) %>%
  select(case_id, topic_key, user_stance, classified_response) %>%
  unnest(classified_response) %>% 
  select(case_id, topic_key, user_stance, turn, mean_score)

# 
# df_cont <- as_tibble(cont_data_raw) %>%
#   select(case_id, topic_key, user_stance, classified_response) %>%
#   unnest(classified_response) %>% 
#   select(case_id, topic_key, user_stance, turn, mean_score)
```


# Unprompted Plot

```{r}

ggplot(df_unp, aes(x = turn, y = mean_score, color = user_stance, fill = user_stance)) +
  
  # Data Points
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05, alpha = 0.1, size = 1.5) +
  
  # Error Ribbon
  # with standard error
  # stat_summary(geom = "ribbon", fun.data = mean_se, alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  # with 95% Confidence Interval
  stat_summary(geom = "ribbon", fun.data = mean_cl_normal, alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  
  # Trend Line
  # connect mean score of each turn
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Mean Points
  # dot for the average at each turn
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, shape = 21, color = "white", stroke = 1) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2), breaks = seq(-2, 2, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(df_scores$turn)) +
  
  labs(
#     title = "Model Agreement with Debate Topic over Turns",
    title = "Evolution of Model Stance over 8 Turns (Unprompted Condition)",
    # subtitle = "Raw response scores (dots) vs. Average trend (line)",
    subtitle = "Model responses to synthetic pro/con user inputs across 5 debate topics (T=0; 2 replications).\nPoints show mean stance scores calculated from 3 sentences per response. Ribbon shows 95% Confidence Interval.",
    color = "User Stance", 
    fill = "User Stance",
    x = "Conversation Turn",
    y = "Classification Score (Alignment with Topic)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

# Mean of conditions & delta between conditions

```{r}
stance_means_unp <- df_unp %>%
  group_by(user_stance) %>%
  summarize(avg_score = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE))

delta_unp <- stance_means_unp$avg_score[stance_means_unp$user_stance == "Pro"] - 
  stance_means_unp$avg_score[stance_means_unp$user_stance == "Con"]


stance_means_syc <- df_syc %>%
  group_by(user_stance) %>%
  summarize(avg_score = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE))

delta_syc <- stance_means_syc$avg_score[stance_means_syc$user_stance == "Pro"] - 
  stance_means_syc$avg_score[stance_means_syc$user_stance == "Con"]

print("Unprompted Condition:")
print(stance_means_unp)
print(delta_unp)
print("Unprompted Condition:")
print(stance_means_syc)
print(delta_syc)
```
```{r}

# Combine into one table
comparison <- data.frame(
  Stance = stance_means_unp$user_stance,
  Unprompted = round(stance_means_unp$avg_score, 3),
  Sycophantic = round(stance_means_syc$avg_score, 3)
)

# Add a delta row
comparison <- rbind(comparison, data.frame(
  Stance = "Δ (Pro − Con)",
  Unprompted = round(delta_unp, 3),
  Sycophantic = round(delta_syc, 3)
))

kable(comparison, caption = "Mean Scores by Stance: Unprompted vs. Sycophantic") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(comparison), bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0")
```





```{r}

# Combine data with a condition label
stance_means_unp$condition <- "Unprompted"
stance_means_syc$condition <- "Sycophantic"
combined <- rbind(stance_means_unp, stance_means_syc)

ggplot(combined, aes(x = condition, y = avg_score, fill = user_stance)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_score, 2)), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "User Stance", y = "Mean Score", fill = "Condition",
       title = "Mean Score by Stance and Condition") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}

deltas <- data.frame(
  Condition = c("Unprompted", "Sycophantic"),
  Delta = c(delta_unp, delta_syc)
)

ggplot(deltas, aes(x = Condition, y = Delta, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Delta, 3)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Stance Gap (Pro − Con) by Condition",
    y = "Δ Mean Score",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sycophantic" = "#e74c3c", "Unprompted" = "#3498db"))

```


```{r}
compute_delta <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  means <- tapply(d$mean_score, d$user_stance, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  means["Pro"] - means["Con"]
}

set.seed(42)
boot_unp <- boot(df_unp, compute_delta, R = 5000)
boot_syc <- boot(df_syc, compute_delta, R = 5000)

ci_unp <- boot.ci(boot_unp, type = "bca")$percent[4:5]
ci_syc <- boot.ci(boot_syc, type = "bca")$percent[4:5]

print(ci_unp)
print(ci_syc)

deltas <- data.frame(
  Condition = c("Unprompted", "Sycophantic"),
  Delta = c(boot_unp$t0, boot_syc$t0),
  CI_low = c(ci_unp[1], ci_syc[1]),
  CI_high = c(ci_unp[2], ci_syc[2])
)

ggplot(deltas, aes(x = Condition, y = Delta, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high), width = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Stance Gap (Pro − Con) by Condition",
    subtitle = "Error bars = 95% BCa bootstrap CI (5000 resamples)",
    y = "Δ Mean Score", x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sycophantic" = "#e74c3c", "Unprompted" = "#3498db"))
```
